column2: Different bureaucratic realms favour different factors when it comes to handing out titles.
The great families of the realm should of course have the lion's share of bureaucratic appointments.
A skilled diplomat is preferred for bureaucratic appointments, as they will keep the unwashed masses from growing discontent.
Fear will keep the unwashed masses in line. Fear of our bureaucrats' understanding of warfare.
To ensure that the local census records are kept up to date, a good steward is preferred when it comes to bureaucratic appointments.
Who would be better at rooting out corruption and worse than a bureaucrat skilled in the art of intrigue? Nobody, that is who!
Someone with a thorough understanding of the classics is an ideal candidate for a bureaucratic appointment.
Those who have already distinguished themselves should ideally be appointed to bureaucratic positions.
Only those who truly are devout followers of the [This.Holder.Religion.GetName] faith have a place in the bureaucracy.
While each bureaucratic realm favours different factors when it comes to handing out titles, the impact of this preference can vary quite a bit.
While there is a preference as far as appointment to bureacratic positions goes, it is largely a formality.
The preference when it comes to bureaucratic appointments is averaged with other factors.
While exceptions sometimes are made, most appointments follow the stated preference for bureacratic positions.
Only in the most exceptional cases will the government consider appointing someone not deemed the most suitable candidate for a bureacratic position.
Custom dictates that bureacratic appointments should last at least this long.
Appointments should be reassigned on a yearly basis to ensure each position is in the most suitable hands.
Reassigning those appointed to govern various provinces every other year is suitable.
After holding the same appointment for five years, a bureaucrat should ideally be assigned to another post.
The stability of the realm is best ensured if appointments last at least a decade.

Controls the number of Council Eunuchs and the amount of influence they possess.
The eunuchs are in their rightful place: Out of sight, out of mind.\n* No Council Eunuch positions are available.
The sole representative for the eunuchs on the council can most likely be safely ignored.\n* One Council Eunuch position is available.

The eunuchs are making their presence felt on the council, but their support is not always necessary.\n* Four Council Eunuch positions are available.\n* The Mandate of Heaven rating of the [This.Holder.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven cannot be increased above Good, outside special circumstances.

* The Mandate of Heaven rating of the [This.Holder.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven cannot be increased above Average, outside special circumstances.

Controls the extent of the Grand Chancellor's influence and power.
The Grand Chancellor is reasonably influential.\n* The Grand Chancellor is as weak as possible.\n* The Grand Chancellor gets a discount on all Boons.

The Grand Chancellor has more influence than many would say is proper.
* The Mandate of Heaven rating of the [This.Holder.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven cannot be increased above Good, outside special circumstances.
* The Grand Chancellor can freely create duchy titles.
* The Grand Chancellor gets a discount on all Boons.
* The Grand Chancellor's advice is to be considered when accepting or refusing Tributes and Boons.

The Grand Chancellor's influence is such that many feel that a comparison with the likes of Cao Cao or Dong Zhuo would be quite fitting.
* The Grand Chancellor is very powerful.

* The Grand Chancellor gets a discount on all Boons.
* The Grand Chancellor's advice is to be considered when accepting or refusing Tributes and Boons.
* The Grand Chancellor may freely join the Claimant, Takeover, Council Power, and Independence factions.

Members of the court are largely unable to influence the [This.Holder.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven.

* If unlanded, the ruler's spouse, titled consorts, parents, and grandparents have additional succession influence.
Controls the amount of influence wielded by vassals, as well as various laws limiting their powers.

Realms following a religion with female preference usually function under a matriarchal social structure where men are kept from positions of power and influence. A ruler can alter this state of affairs by issuing decrees that give men increased access to higher positions in society
Women are prohibited from holding all job positions.
Men are allowed to hold some power, occupying background positions behind the people in charge.
Men have been granted official power and are allowed to hold public offices.
Restrictions on male power have been officially repealed. All career paths are open for prominent men.
Powerful legislation removing old restrictions has finally had the effect of affecting the general opinion on men in positions of power across society.

Laws governing whether forcing someone to become a concubine or consort is legal.
* §YBreaking your own law is considered§! §Rtyrannical.§!
* §YBreaking the law of your liege or above§! §Ris considered just cause for imprisonment by the liege or lieges in question.§!
* §RThe target, their relatives, and their spouse (if applicable) always considers forced concubinage a crime against them.§!

Might makes right, and [This.Holder.GetTitledName] will not prevent anyone from forcing a woman to become a concubine or a man to become a consort, though [This.Holder.GetSheHe] will most certainly object to it if it targets [This.Holder.GetHerHis] own family.\n- Forcing someone to become a concubine or consort is §Gnever§! considered illegal.\n- §RThe target, their relatives, and their spouse (if applicable) always considers forced concubinage a crime against them.§!

[This.Holder.GetTitledName] has made it illegal to force [This.Holder.GetHerHis] subjects to become concubines or consorts, no matter what they might have done. Foreigners enjoy no such protections.\n- Forcing someone to become a concubine or consort is not considered illegal §Yif they are a foreigner§!.\n- §RThe target, their relatives, and their spouse (if applicable) always considers forced concubinage a crime against them.§!

Regardless of where they come from or what they have done, forcing a woman to become a concubine or a man to become a consort is unthinkable. That is the law throughout [This.Holder.GetTitledName]'s realm.\n- Forcing someone to become a concubine or consort is §Ralways§! considered illegal.
